parsed.reason: All facts are accurate and complete: intros switched off, pending ones closed, texting to turn back on works, and closed ones stay closed. No invented promises, no apology, no medical or other-family hints. The Japanese is natural, polite desu/masu register appropriate for a stranger-parent, and reads like a person texting rather than a log entry. Slight stiffness in the closing 'ただ、閉じた紹介はそのままです' keeps it from feeling perfectly chatty, but it is warm and plain.
